published_ranges._notes: TDS V1.0 (2025/12/1) titled 'KINGROON PLA Silk Dual-Color' (download-centre label says 'PLA Silk+', file KINGROON_PLA_Silk_Technical_Data_Sheet_V1.0_ef5dac60...). HDT 1.8MPa 50C; Cool/High Temp/Textured PEI with glue; fan on; overhang 55deg, bridging 30mm. Retraction/print-speed/chamber label mapping inferred from the flattened PDF layout (value order matches the other Kingroon V1.0 TDS sheets: retraction length, retraction speed, chamber temp, overhang, bridging ... printing speed). Dual-colour product page not re-read this run. Earlier entry: TDS titled 'PLA Silk' and describes KINGROON PLA Silk Dual-Color. Cool Plate / High Temperature Plate / Textured PEI with glue; fan on; HDT 1.8 MPa 50 C; melting 152 C; ABS spool rated 70 C. Verification 2026-11-01: fields and plate/chamber/fan/retraction ranges confirmed against the TDS PDF; kingroon.com / kingroon3d.com product pages returned HTTP 429, so page-derived notes and conflicts were not re-checked.
